source.citation: Sarkar et al., J. Chem. Theory Comput. 2022, 18, 2418-2436
source.energy_order: TBE / paper PC-NEVPT2, both aug-cc-pVTZ, eV
source.scope: Conservative 27-molecule single-excitation-dominated set discussed in this workflow, including Acetaldehyde and Furan. Molecules with an explicitly identified pure or significant double-excitation state are excluded at the molecule level.

notes: Lowest singlet and triplet valence n->pi* states. A specialized CAS(4,3) acetaldehyde workflow is included in the bundle as an inspectable example.
Higher A-prime singlets exhibit valence/Rydberg mixing in the paper.
Linear Coov mapping uses one component (E2x) for Delta states; E2y is degenerate.
Linear Dooh mapping uses one component (E2ux) for Delta_u states; E2uy is degenerate.
Linear Dooh mapping uses one component (E2ux) for Delta_u states; E2uy is degenerate.
The authors explicitly describe the selected Furan excited states as having highly dominant single-excitation character.
The specialized Furan script included in this bundle targets the four valence pi->pi* states with a CAS(6,5) proof-of-concept workflow.
The two singlet A1 states have non-negligible higher-excitation contributions.
All reported states are single-excitation dominated; the least single-like state is reported as 84.2% single character.
PySCF reduces D3h to a supported subgroup; edit pyscf_wfnsym in the prepared case file after inspecting the detected group.
